result.instructions: Tools for urlscan.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Scan this suspicious link privately and tell me what the page does: https://example.com/login"; "Have there been any scans of example.com in the last 7 days? Show the titles and IPs."; "Find recent scans of pages titled "Sign in" hosted on AS13335.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes urlscan.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run urlscan_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run urlscan_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run urlscan_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. urlscan_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: urlscan_get_quotas
tools.title: Get API quotas
tools.description: Your urlscan.io API quotas and current usage, per action (public / unlisted / private scans, search, result retrieval, ...) and per minute, hour and day: limit, used, remaining, percent. Check it before submitting scans. GET /api/v1/quotas.

tools.name: urlscan_list_scan_countries
tools.title: List scan countries
tools.description: Two-letter country codes a scan can be run from (the `country` option of urlscan_submit_scan). Free plans may only be able to pick a country for public scans. GET /api/v1/availableCountries.

tools.name: urlscan_search
tools.title: Search scans
tools.description: Search urlscan.io's index of past scans (public scans by anyone, plus your own unlisted/private scans). `q` is an Elasticsearch query string, e.g. `domain:example.com`, `page.domain:example.com AND date:>now-7d`, `ip:1.2.3.4`, `page.asn:AS13335`, `hash:<sha256>`, `filename:login.js`, `task.tags:phishing`, `page.title:"Sign in"`. Returns per hit: scan_id, URL, domain, IP, country, ASN, title, status, stats, and links to the result page and screenshot. Pass next_search_after as search_after for the next (older) page. Free keys can only search a limited number of recent days (search_date_limit_days in the reply). GET /api/v1/search/.

q.description: Elasticsearch query string, e.g. domain:example.com AND date:>now-7d

search_after.description: Paging cursor: the previous reply's next_search_after.

tools.name: urlscan_submit_scan
tools.title: Submit a URL scan
tools.description: WRITE: submit ONE URL to urlscan.io to be loaded in a sandbox browser and analysed. It uses your scan quota for the chosen visibility (the free plan has 50 private scans per day; check urlscan_get_quotas), and urlscan.io's browser will visit the URL. Visibility defaults to PRIVATE (visible only to you). `unlisted` shows the URL to vetted security researchers; `public` shows the URL and the whole result to everyone on urlscan.io: use it only for URLs that carry no personal or non-public information. Returns the scan_id and links; the result is ready after about 10-30 seconds: call urlscan_get_scan_result (it reports `pending` until then). If the account has "Enforce visibility" enabled in its urlscan.io settings, that setting overrides the requested visibility (the reply then carries a warning). Never put passwords, tokens or personal data in the URL. POST /api/v1/scan/.

url.description: The ONE absolute http(s) URL to scan, e.g. https://example.com/login.

visibility.description: Who can see the scan: private (default, only you), unlisted (you + vetted researchers), public (everyone).

country.description: Scan from this country (two-letter code; see urlscan_list_scan_countries). Omit to let urlscan.io choose.

tags.description: Up to 10 tags (max 30 characters each) to annotate the scan.

tools.name: urlscan_get_scan_result
tools.title: Get scan result
tools.description: The result of a scan, summarised: verdicts (overall, urlscan, engines, community: score, malicious, categories, brands), page facts (IP, country, ASN, server, title, HTTP status, domain age, TLS), request stats, contacted domains / IPs / URLs / file hashes (capped lists), detected technologies, downloads, the redirect chain, and LINKS to the result page, screenshot and DOM snapshot (the screenshot and DOM are not returned as data). Cookies, storage and response bodies are left out. If the scan has not finished the answer is status `pending`: retry in 5-10 seconds. Needs an API key to read. GET /api/v1/result/{scan_id}/.

scan_id.description: Scan id (UUID) from urlscan_submit_scan or urlscan_search.
